description: This Java class implements a media playback service using Android's MediaBrowserService, MediaSession, and Playback APIs. It manages media browsing, playback controls, media metadata, and notifications for a media app, specifically handling music playback with queue management, media session callbacks, and integration with Android Auto.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: An Android media playback service managing media session, playback queue, media controls, and notifications for music playback.

classes.name: MediaSessionCallback
classes.description: Inner class extending MediaSession.Callback to handle media control actions like play, pause, skip, seek, and custom actions.

classes.name: DelayedStopHandler
classes.description: Static inner class extending Handler to delay stopping the service when playback stops.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes media session, playback, media provider, and notification manager.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents for playback commands like pause.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases resources and stops the service.

methods.name: onGetRoot
methods.description: Provides the root media ID for media browsing, validating caller permissions.

methods.name: onLoadChildren
methods.description: Loads media items for a given media ID, asynchronously retrieving media catalog if needed.

methods.name: loadChildrenImpl
methods.description: Internal method to generate media items list based on parent media ID.

methods.name: handlePlayRequest
methods.description: Starts playback of the current media item, ensuring service and session are active.

methods.name: handlePauseRequest
methods.description: Pauses playback and schedules delayed service stop.

methods.name: handleStopRequest
methods.description: Stops playback, updates state, and schedules delayed service stop.

methods.name: updateMetadata
methods.description: Updates media session metadata, including album art fetching.

methods.name: updatePlaybackState
methods.description: Updates the playback state, including error handling and notification updates.

methods.name: setCustomAction
methods.description: Adds custom actions like favorite toggle to playback state.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Determines available playback actions based on current state and queue.

methods.name: getCurrentPlayingMusic
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of the currently playing music.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Handles end of media playback, advancing queue or stopping.

methods.name: onPlaybackStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates playback state when status changes.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles playback errors and updates state accordingly.
